en.title: Left Something in a Jeju Taxi? How to Find the Driver (Kakao T & Street Taxis)
en.desc: Lost your phone, wallet or bag in a taxi in Jeju? How to reach the driver through Kakao T, your card payment or receipt, and what to do if you've already left Korea.
en.h1: Lost Something in a Jeju Taxi
summary: Booked with Kakao T? Open the app → ride history → select the ride and contact the driver or report a lost item. This is the fastest route.
Hailed a taxi on the street? Your receipt or card payment record can identify the car — the receipt usually shows the car number and a contact number.
Nothing works? Call Jeju's 120 call center (dial 120 from a Korean phone) or report it to the police. Already left Korea? Jeju Live can collect it from the driver for you.

sections.body:
App rides are the easiest to trace because the app keeps the car number and the driver's contact.

  1. Open Kakao T → ride history (이용기록).
  2. Select the ride. Call or message the driver, or choose the lost-item report option.
  3. If you can't reach the driver, use the in-app customer support chat and give the date, time and route.

Act within the same day if you can — drivers often find items when the next passenger gets in.

sections.h: If you hailed a taxi on the street
sections.body:
• Receipt: it usually shows the car number and the company's or driver's phone number.
  • Paid by card at the meter: the company that runs the taxi's card terminal can look up the car from your card number or approval number. The receipt shows which company it is (e.g. T-money, Cashbee) — contact that company. Your card issuer can also help.
  • Paid by mobile wallet: you may need the approval number from your payment app's history.
  • Paid cash, no receipt: note where and when you got in and out, and the taxi's colour.

• Jeju 120 Mandeok Call Center — dial 120 from a Korean phone. Jeju's public information line; tell them the pickup/drop-off place and time.
  • Korea Taxi Association lost & found — online report at taxi.or.kr.
  • Police — drivers and passengers often hand items to the nearest police box. Once registered, they appear in the police lost-property database, which Jeju Live's live search shows for Jeju.
  • 1330 — the free 24-hour travel helpline can interpret your call with the driver or call center.

If the driver has your item but you're no longer in Jeju, someone has to meet the driver and send it on. Jeju Live's proxy pickup does exactly that: we arrange a meeting with the driver or the police box, collect the item and ship it to you.

A small thank-you payment to the driver is common in Korea but not required.

faq.q: I don't remember the taxi number. Can I still find it?
faq.a: Often yes. Kakao T ride history, your card payment record or your receipt can identify the car. Without any of those, give the pickup and drop-off place and time to the 120 call center or police.

faq.q: Does Kakao T have English support?
faq.a: The app has limited English and automatic translation for chat with drivers. If language is a problem, call 1330 for free interpretation.

faq.q: The driver found my phone but I've left Jeju. What now?
faq.a: Submit a Jeju Live proxy pickup request with the driver's contact. We collect it in Jeju and arrange delivery to you.

zh.title: 济州出租车丢东西怎么办？找司机的方法（Kakao T 及路边打车）
zh.desc: 在济州打车把手机、钱包、包落在车上？通过 Kakao T、刷卡记录或小票找到司机的方法，以及回国后怎么把东西拿回来。
summary: 用 Kakao T 叫的车？打开 App → 行程记录 → 选择该行程，直接联系司机或提交遗失物登记，这是最快的办法。
路边拦的车？小票或刷卡记录可以查到车辆——小票上通常印有车牌号和联系电话。
都不行？拨打济州120咨询中心（用韩国手机拨打120）或报警。已经回国？Jeju Live 可以替你向司机取回。

sections.h: 用 Kakao T 叫的车
sections.body:
App 叫车最好找，因为 App 会保存车牌号和司机联系方式。

  1. 打开 Kakao T → 行程记录（이용기록）。
  2. 选择这次行程，给司机打电话或发消息，或选择遗失物登记。
  3. 联系不上司机时，用 App 内客服聊天，提供日期、时间和路线。

尽量当天处理——下一位乘客上车时，司机往往就会发现落下的东西。

• 小票：通常印有车牌号和出租车公司或司机的电话。
  • 在计价器上刷卡：出租车刷卡终端的运营公司可以用卡号或授权号码查到车辆，小票上会显示是哪家公司（如 T-money、Cashbee），请联系该公司，也可以咨询发卡银行。
  • 用手机支付：可能需要支付记录里的授权号码。
  • 付现金且没拿小票：记下上下车地点、时间和出租车颜色。

• 济州120万德咨询中心——用韩国手机拨打120，济州公共咨询热线，告诉他们上下车地点和时间。
  • 韩国出租车联合会失物中心——可在 taxi.or.kr 网上登记。
  • 警察——司机或乘客常把物品交到附近派出所。登记后会进入警方失物数据库，Jeju Live 实时失物查询可以用中文查看济州的数据。
  • 1330——免费24小时旅游热线，可以提供中文翻译，帮你和司机或客服沟通。

东西在司机手上，但你已经不在济州，就需要有人去和司机碰面再寄给你。Jeju Live 代领服务就是做这件事：我们联系司机或派出所，取回物品后寄给你，可通过微信沟通。

在韩国给司机一点谢礼很常见，但不是必须的。

faq.q: 不记得车牌号还能找到吗？
faq.a: 通常可以。Kakao T 行程记录、刷卡记录或小票都能查到车辆。都没有的话，把上下车地点和时间告诉120咨询中心或警察。
App 支持有限，和司机聊天有自动翻译。语言不通时，拨打1330可获得免费中文翻译。

faq.q: 司机找到了手机，但我已经回国了怎么办？
faq.a: 提交 Jeju Live 代领申请并附上司机联系方式，我们在济州取回后安排寄送。
